The aforesaid case has been registered on the basis of F.I.R lodged on 20.05.2022 alleging that a fraud committed by making false claims in respect of insurance claims.
The amounts have been withdrawn to a particular bank account and the applicant had introduced the account holder at the time of opening of the account.
4. In the affidavit filed in support of the bail application, it has been stated that the applicant is innocent person and he has been falsely implicated in the present case.
5. It has been further stated in the affidavit that the applicant is an illiterate person and he can only make his signatures.
The account opening form contains the photograph of Babban Khan, who is known to the applicant.
6. The learned counsel for the applicant has submitted that the applicant had signed the bank account opening form after seeing the photograph of Babban Khan.
7. The matter requires consideration.
8. The learned A.G.A may file a counter affidavit within a period of three weeks.
9. Rejoinder affidavit, if any, may be filed within a period of two weeks thereafter.

10. List this case in the week commencing 14.08.2023.
11.

4. Although a counter affidavit has been filed, nothing has come to light which may persuade this Court to take a view, different from the view taken while passing the aforesaid order, nor the learned A.G.A. has pointed out violation of any of the conditions of interim anticipatory bail committed by the applicant.
5.
In view of the aforesaid circumstances, the interim order dated 07.07.2023 is hereby made absolute and the application is allowed in terms of the aforesaid order.

In view of the above, in the event of arrest, let the accused-applicant Jakir Khan,
be released on interim anticipatory bail in the aforesaid case on furnishing a personal bond with two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the Station House Officer of the police station/Court concerned with the following conditions:-
(i) that the applicant shall make himself available for interrogation by a police officer as and when required;
(ii) that the applicant shall not, directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence;
(iii) that the applicant shall surrender his passport, if any, to the concerned trial Court forthwith.
In case of breach of any of the above conditions the court below shall have the liberty to cancel the interim anticipatory bail granted to the applicant."
